method: Isolated private CPU copy records exact instruction fetch byte extents, including prefixes; synthetic fetch checks and full emulator RAM parity are required.
limits: These are executed candidate code extents in three paths, not a complete or immutable code classification. Two fetched byte positions vary during each replay. The instruction bytes, fetched addresses and any disassembly remain private; unexecuted paths, overlays and the 16,381 other unknown bytes are unclassified.
